dedupe_keys.name: hanze database of historical flood impacts in europe 1870 2020

description: The Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research publishes HANZE, historical flood impacts in 42 European countries during 1870–2020. The inspected update contains 2,521 riverine, pluvial, coastal and compound events, each with at least one impact statistic. CSV tables give inundated area, fatalities, affected people or economic losses, while Shapefiles locate affected subnational regions. Supporting tables document sources, currencies, deflators and regional codes. Zenodo provides public, free access under CC-BY-4.0. Losses are available in original terms and adjusted to 2020 euros. Uneven reporting across more than 800 sources and administrative, not hydraulic footprints remain limitations. The records can support calibration of regional flood-impact simulations and checks of historical loss scenarios. HANZE complements its separate exposure reconstruction with observed consequences and a traceable bibliography. The update repairs geometries and changes event entries, so version identity matters.
